neighbours.label: anaphoric determiners and pro-forms (this, its, these, here) that point back to something just mentioned, as against 'the', 'a' or quantifiers in the same slot
fire: The valve sometimes sticks open. If this happens, turn off the main supply.
The engine was rebuilt in May, and its power has nearly doubled.
Two new drugs were tested in mice, and these compounds slowed the disease.
We anchored in the bay at dusk, but the winds here shifted all night.
The printer jams on thick paper. When this occurs, open the rear tray.
The bridge reopened last week, and its deck was fully repaved.
Several fossils turned up in the quarry, and these bones are very old.
The path drops into the valley, and the ground here is soft and wet.
quiet: The valve sometimes sticks open. If the pressure drops, turn off the main supply.
The engine was rebuilt in May, and the power has nearly doubled.
Two new drugs were tested in mice, and both compounds slowed the disease.
We anchored in the bay at dusk, but the winds shifted all night.
The printer jams on thick paper. When a sheet sticks, open the rear tray.
The bridge reopened last week, and the deck was fully repaved.
Several fossils turned up in the quarry, and some bones are very old.
The path drops into the valley, and the ground is soft and wet.
